name: City of Toronto Application Information Centre
update_frequency: Daily refresh, according to the City of Toronto page
known_limitations: The portal supports application-level planning context for Toronto, but it does not represent all Ontario municipalities, prove servicing capacity, explain financing exposure, or convert active applications into starts, completions, or occupied units.
notes: Official City of Toronto planning and development application portal. Phase 50B selected application 24 254930 ESC 20 OZ and the City Clerk's 2025-08-29 public notice. Phase 51 selected a separate June 22, 2026 decision report for the revised proposal and servicing review rather than inferring status from the portal.
